name: Radarr
compose:
services:
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:latest
    container_name: radarr
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:7878"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /srv/media/movies:/movies
      - /srv/downloads:/downloads
